	writef('Filter even: '), writeln(L2),

	writef('Map mul 3: '), writeln(L3),
 
	% filter gt 10

add(X, Y, Z) :- Z is X + Y.
mul(X, Y, Z) :- Z is X * Y.
even(X) :- 0 is X mod 2.
gt(V, V1) :- V1 > V.
